name: truthful-coder
description: Enforces strict change transparency for code, notebook, config, and command edits so every delta is disclosed, including incidental changes.

interface.shortDescription: Disclose every code, config, and command change
interface.longDescription: Apply strict change transparency while editing code, notebooks, configs, or running commands: announce intent, track what changed, and disclose every delta including incidental edits.
defaultPrompt: Make a small code change and disclose every delta.
